body: Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs (Fable2, 2026-10-05 about 05:00Z; supersedes the 2d0f7204 hash for Engram 3abe2b2). Engram bd2c5af (L-F2b) is installed: exe sha256 690c5acfba5fd63faccd638d8228fc5c0bddf8f1de87411c671fad8721f30c38, build_fingerprint 457ac849498982ac9ad1964a9318a000c2f16066bcaf3401df5942de1b0a40fe (install notice: Engram::Fable, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #660). A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses this sha256 until the next install notice. bd2c5af changes responses only: CLI and MCP errors name items by short ref (WorkAncestorNotOpen, RequiredChildUnsealed), and a refused `next --peek` offers `next --peek`. There is no schema change. Running MCP sessions pick it up at the next TermAl restart.
